title_es: Límites de Trabajo en Progreso y Flujo
body_es: Los límites de Trabajo en Progreso (WIP) establecen el número máximo de tareas que pueden estar simultáneamente en una etapa del flujo. Al limitar WIP, el equipo evita la multitarea destructiva, reduce el tiempo de ciclo y mejora la calidad, porque el enfoque se concentra en completar menos cosas simultáneamente. El flujo óptimo ocurre cuando las tareas se mueven fluidamente a través del pipeline sin cuellos de botella; los equipos usan métricas como lead time y cycle time para identificar y resolver obstáculos en el flujo. Un buen flujo también reduce la acumulación de trabajo en progreso, libera capacidad mental y permite que el equipo entregue valor más rápidamente.
body_en: Work In Progress (WIP) limits establish the maximum number of tasks that can simultaneously be in a stage of the flow. By limiting WIP, the team avoids destructive multitasking, reduces cycle time, and improves quality because focus concentrates on completing fewer things simultaneously. Optimal flow occurs when tasks move smoothly through the pipeline without bottlenecks; teams use metrics like lead time and cycle time to identify and resolve flow obstacles. Good flow also reduces work-in-progress accumulation, frees mental capacity, and enables the team to deliver value more quickly.
example_code:
# WIP Limits and Flow Management (YAML)
wip_management:
  scenario_1:
    title: "Without WIP Limits"
    in_progress_count: 12
    team_size: 5
    context_switches: "Frequent"
    average_cycle_time: "10 days"
    quality: "Poor"
    issues: "Multitasking, bottlenecks accumulate"
  
  scenario_2:
    title: "With WIP Limits (5 max)"
    in_progress_count: 5
    team_size: 5
    context_switches: "Minimal"
    average_cycle_time: "3 days"
    quality: "High"
    benefits: "Focus, faster delivery, better quality"
  
  flow_optimization:
    column_limits:
      to_do: "No limit (source of work)"
      in_progress: "5 maximum"
      in_review: "3 maximum"
      testing: "4 maximum"
      done: "No limit"
    
    when_wip_exceeded:
      action: "Stop starting, start finishing"
      priority: "Complete items before new ones"
      mentality: "Quality over quantity"

  key_metrics:
    lead_time: "Time from request to delivery"
    cycle_time: "Time from start to completion"
    throughput: "Items completed per week"
example_output:
Flow Analysis:

Before WIP Limits:
- Average cycle time: 10 days
- WIP accumulation: 12 items
- Team stress: High
- Quality issues: 8 bugs/sprint

After Implementing WIP = 5:
- Average cycle time: 3 days
- WIP accumulation: 5 items (controlled)
- Team stress: Low
- Quality issues: 1 bug/sprint

Improvement: 70% faster delivery, 87% fewer bugs
